intent: A snap-on lid for an open-top box: a flat rectangular plate with two flexible snap prongs projecting from the underside that engage the outside of the box walls as a snap fit. Plate prints flat on the bed.

parts.description: Lid plate 80x50x2 with two 4x3x4 snap prongs underneath

interfaces.description: Two prongs engage the box walls

engineering_rationale.load_path: snap prong flexes at its root when engaging/disengaging the box wall
engineering_rationale.worst_case_stress: prong root, bending at full deflection
